svg.aria-label: Bupples. App Store and Google Play · 1.4.6. Split the bill, skip the awkward follow-up. Scan a receipt, tap who had what, and Bupples works out who owes whom, to the cent. Built with Flutter, Firebase and Vertex AI. The screenshot shows the receipt claim, Home and hangout balance screens.
